assumptions: Demonstration only: depot assignment, 3 vehicles, capacity 200 units, each receiving site demand 30 units, 09:00–17:00 service windows, 15-minute service, depot 08:00–18:00. Receiving sites are 11 public hospital sites and 3 private hospitals; the demand, fleet and windows are project assumptions, not orders from these institutions. No commercial relationship or actual shipment data implied. Supply points (2026-09-16): the main warehouse and three regional depots are simulated front-warehouse roles assigned to four Scarlett Supermarket outlets; outlet addresses come from the public outlet directory (location.sggreatpromo.com, retrieved 2026-09-16). These are retail mall units without pharmaceutical cold-chain capability — a project assumption, not a claim about the retailer. The former Kuehne+Nagel Pioneer depot is kept as a third-party warehouse for comparison. Depot/warehouse opening window 08:00-18:00.

nodes.name: Singapore General Hospital
nodes.note: 2026-09-15 取代 National Heart Centre Singapore：SGH 在 SGDI 的 MOH 医院名单上（NHCS 是专科中心、不在该名单），且两者同在 Outram 院区、实测相距仅约 107 m，同时保留会让地图上出现两个几乎重合的停靠点。⚠️ 该节点需要 geocoder_accept 例外：OSMnx 的 geocoder 用 dedupe=0 时，「Singapore General Hospital」的首条结果是同名分区（type=administrative，即医院所在分区），换过 Outram Road / Hospital Drive / Block 1 等多种说法均无法拿到 type=hospital 的医院实体（Hospital Drive 那条返回的是 NHCS）。另用不带 dedupe 的查询交叉核对，医院实体坐标 (1.27945, 103.83627) 与分区一致、距 NHCS 约 107 m，故位置可信。
